name: git-worktree
description: 基于用户需求创建 git 分支与工作树：从用户原始提示词提取关键词生成分支名，创建工作树目录（即本次 run 的运行目录），将后续流水线的工作目录切换到该工作树，并刷写 context 阶段的延迟产物到 worktree。

prompt.instruction:
1. Read skill://atom-tasks/git-worktree/branch-rules.json to get the branch naming template and config.
2. Read skill://config.json to get the base.targetDir setting.
3. Extract a description slug from the user's original prompt (the message that triggered this skill). Take the first meaningful sentence or phrase (skip activation keywords like 'use ddo-code-flow'), convert to kebab-case: lowercase, strip special chars, collapse whitespace to hyphens. Truncate to 50 chars. If extraction fails, use branch-rules.json defaults.descriptionFallback.
4. Generate the branch name by substituting placeholders in the template: {prefix} → defaults.prefix, {date} → today's date (YYYY-MM-DD), {description} → the extracted slug. Join with defaults.separator. Truncate the final name to defaults.maxBranchNameLength. Record the {prefix} value as 'type' (e.g. feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test, perf, ci, build).
   Also derive two values from the branch name:
   - 'type' = the part before the first '/' (e.g. 'feat' from 'feat/2026-06-24-add-dark-mode')
   - 'dateDescription' = the part after the first '/' (e.g. '2026-06-24-add-dark-mode')
5. Compute the worktree directory name and path:
   a. Get the project name: basename of the project root directory (e.g. 'Ddo-Code-Flow').
   b. Worktree directory name = '<projectName>-<branchName with / replaced by ->'. Example: branch 'feat/2026-06-24-add-dark-mode' → worktree dir 'Ddo-Code-Flow-feat-2026-06-24-add-dark-mode'.
   c. Worktree path = resolve base.targetDir relative to the project root, then append the worktree directory name. Example: targetDir='..' → '../Ddo-Code-Flow-feat-2026-06-24-add-dark-mode' (sibling of project root).
   d. Record 'dateDescription' (e.g. '2026-06-24-add-dark-mode') — this is used for the artifact subdirectory.
6. If reuseExisting is true, check if a worktree for this branch already exists via 'git worktree list'. If found, reuse it — write worktree-info.json and update .state.json with the existing worktree path.
7. Otherwise, create the branch and worktree:
   a. Run 'git branch <branch-name>' from baseRef. If the branch already exists, append -2, -3, ... until unique.
   b. Run 'git worktree add <worktree-path> <branch-name>' where worktree-path is the computed path from step 5c.
   c. Verify the command succeeded (exit code 0 and the directory exists at the expected path).
8. Create the artifact subdirectory: mkdir -p <worktree-path>/docs/<type>/<dateDescription>/ (e.g. '<worktree-path>/docs/feat/2026-06-24-add-dark-mode/'). All subsequent MD artifacts and .state.json will be written under this directory.
9. Write run://docs/{type}/{dateDescription}/worktree-info.json with: { branchName, worktreePath (absolute), targetDir, type, dateDescription, baseRef, createdAt (ISO 8601) }.
10. Write .state.json to run://docs/{type}/{dateDescription}/.state.json: set the top-level field 'worktreePath' to the absolute worktree path, 'type' to the branch prefix, and 'dateDescription' to the date-description slug. This causes all subsequent stages to resolve run:// paths relative to the worktree, and run://docs/{type}/{dateDescription}/ paths to the artifact subdirectory.
guardrails: Never modify any files in the main working tree; only operate on the new worktree.
Always verify 'git worktree add' succeeds (exit code 0) before proceeding.
If git commands fail (not a git repo, dirty worktree, etc.), halt and report the error — do not continue the pipeline.
Do not delete or move existing worktrees unless reuseExisting is true and the worktree matches the target branch.
The worktreePath in worktree-info.json MUST be an absolute path.

The worktree directory name MUST be '<projectName>-<branchName>' with slashes replaced by dashes (e.g. 'Ddo-Code-Flow-feat-2026-06-24-add-dark-mode'). It sits directly under targetDir as a sibling of the project root.

The artifact subdirectory MUST be '<worktreePath>/docs/<type>/<dateDescription>/' where type is the branch prefix and dateDescription is the part after the prefix slash (e.g. '<worktreePath>/docs/feat/2026-06-24-add-dark-mode/'). All .state.json, worktree-info.json, and MD artifacts go here.
Never write artifacts directly under targetDir, worktreePath, or worktreePath/docs/. They MUST go under the full docs/<type>/<dateDescription>/ path.
